policy: Mechanical Bengali drafts must not be marked reviewed or verified. Pronunciation requires independent verse-by-verse review against Arabic before publication.
source: Original Arabic and Bengali translations from existing source records; manually authored Bengali-script draft pronunciation is not certified.

audit.method: Compared Arabic fields to Bengali phonetic drafts for Surah 3 and Surahs 43–49, repaired detected issues, verified 505 complete ayah records. Remaining 4118 are unverified older machine-derived pronunciations.
